decisions.thought: Mirror match. Given the uncertainty, immediate KO is safer. Also, Kingambit with Supreme Overlord benefits from fainted allies — leaving it alive matters little since it's 1% HP.

The KO means later, if I bring out Kingambit later, Supreme Overlord on my side benefits... wait my Kingambit has Supreme Overlord too. Fainted opponents count? Supreme Overlord counts fainted allies on your own side. So no.

I'll go with EQ to KO. Keep it simple and consistent with my stated plan.
